text:
Maya: opened a PR to merge the dedicated provisioning migration guide with a compact autoscale SDK example + terraform one-liner for reserved pools. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2501

Alex: reading. two quick things: clarify soft vs hard SLOs (we shouldn't mix percentiles in the same sentence) and fix a broken link I hit.

Sanjay: the terraform snippet references `reserved_pool_id` but doesn't show creating the pool. customers keep assuming pools are implicitly created. can we add the creation example?

Maya: yes. plan: separate SLA bullets, add terraform create example, update SDK example from `set_scale_policy` -> `configure_autoscale` (we deprecated the old name).

Lucy: FYI the current python example throws a DeprecationWarning locally: `DeprecationWarning: set_scale_policy will be removed in v0.12` so switching is required.

Patrick: suggest the autoscale snippet use target_utilization instead of only min/max. short python example suggestion:
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
client.configure_autoscale(reserved_pool_id="rp-xy123", target_utilization=0.7, min_replicas=1, max_replicas=8)
```
This maps better to SLO reasoning.

Alex: also the migration doc links to https://docs.redwood.dev/dedicated/old-provisioning which 404s. doc-linter: `broken-link: line 82`.
doc-linter: broken-link detected in docs/dedicated/migrate.md: line 82 -> https://docs.redwood.dev/dedicated/old-provisioning (404).

Maya: swapped that link to /dedicated/provisioning/migrate and added a short note on preemption for best-effort workloads. added terraform one-liner:
```hcl
resource "redwood_reserved_pool" "migration_demo" {
  name      = "migration-demo"
  gpu_count = 8
  # use isolation_label to segregate tenants where needed
}
```

Sanjay: please annotate with a comment explaining reserved pools are isolated by default but eviction_protection matters for workload-level preemption. some customers confuse these.

Maya: added the isolation comment and a brief paragraph clarifying tenant eviction behavior and eviction_protection.

Lucy: re-tested the updated python snippet with `configure_autoscale` and it runs clean. added a parenthetical in the example explaining units for `target_utilization` (fraction of GPU util, e.g., 0.75 == 75%).

Patrick: can we also include a tiny ascii graph showing how target_utilization maps to replica count over load? adding a screenshot later would be ideal but ascii is good for now.

Maya: added a 1-line sparkline and mapping note. reworked SLA section to three bullets: soft SLOs (p50/p90 guidance), hard SLOs (p99 + fallback policy), and notes about how isolation impacts observed latency.

Chris: quick editorial nits fixed. content-wise LGTM.

Alex: add a migration checklist item: validate `eviction_protection` on jobs before migrating. customers hit preemption surprises otherwise. can you show the CLI to inspect?

Maya: added checklist and example CLI command: `redwood-cli pools describe rp-xy123 --show-eviction-status`

doc-linter: link-check passed after fixes. spell-check: two suggestions (applied).

Maya: pushed updates and requested reviews from @alex and @patrick. PR diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2501/files

Alex: reviewed and approved. clean.

Patrick: approved. follow-up: add console screenshot in separate PR.

Chris: merged minor punctuation fixes. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: PR merged into main by Maya (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/a1b2c3d). Release note: "docs(dedicated): migration guide consolidated; autoscale SDK sample and terraform reserved_pool example added; clarified SLA and isolation wording"

Maya: thanks all. I'll open the screenshot follow-up and a small chore to add an end-to-end validation script sample.

Sanjay: thanks 1- nice to have the terraform create example.

Lucy: great quick turnaround. :rocket:
